An ordering cycle does not mask other middleware diagnostics: the
unresolved constructor binding reports alongside the cycle error.
-- go.mod --
module app

go 1.27
-- main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- web/web.go --
package web

import "net/http"

type Deps struct{}

//fabrik:http:middleware name=a global=true after=b
func A(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware name=b global=true after=a
func B(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware global=true
func NeedsDeps(d *Deps) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }
}

//fabrik:http GET /
func Index(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
-- want/diags --
error: web/web.go:10:51: middleware ordering cycle: a -> b -> a
  help: break the cycle by removing a requires= or after=/before= edge
error: web/web.go:14:16: no provider or binding supplies this middleware constructor parameter
  help: declare a //fabrik:provider for it
